QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: airDataSyncEnabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Allows telemetry logs to be uploaded to AirData using the Flight Upload API.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: airDataUploadToken
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: The pilot's Auto Upload Token, available from the AirData web app under My Account -> Auto Upload Token. Begins with HD.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: airDataAutoUpload
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Uploads each telemetry log to AirData on its own, after the flight ends and whenever a network becomes available.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: airDataWifiOnly
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Holds automatic uploads until the controller is on an unmetered network, so logs do not consume a mobile data allowance. Manual uploads ignore this.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: airDataAppKey
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Overrides the AirData app key compiled into this build. Normally left blank; used for testing against a different app key without rebuilding.
